single_move: Turn finite Fourier evidence at the eight DTMF frequencies into an explicit, falsifiable row-plus-column key-or-reject decision with declared tolerance, timing, latency, and cost contracts.

repairs.resolution: The brief and course notes now identify only deterministic synthetic DTMF PCM and the 101-tap 300–3400 Hz course FIR. Deployed, standards-conforming, real acoustic, reverberation, clipping, speech, dial-tone, echo, and browser-recording claims were removed.

The named AT&T Q.24 Annex A profile is explicit: <=23 ms is the non-operation side, >=40 ms is the operation side, and 23–40 ms is gray. In the concurrent corpus repair, 20 ms is mandatory non-operation, 25 ms is explicitly indeterminate and excluded from conformance accuracy, and 45 ms is above the operation boundary.

N=205 is now a 25.625 ms spectral-feature frame only. Temporal qualification requires at least 320 received samples. Primary latency begins at received-signal onset; source-onset latency separately includes the FIR's measured 50-sample/6.25 ms delay plus frame/hop alignment.

Exact-nominal C(f), N=205 bins, and padded N=256 FFT bins are explicitly distinct. The strategy exercise now permits only same-coordinate comparisons and requires separate real/complex/historical operation ledgers.
The nonexistent seeded 12-key fixture and identical-decision claim were removed. The exercise is now a coordinate-safe strategy specification and does not invent test outcomes.

The authoring contract now requires one accepted member per group plus frequency, energy/dominance, twist, duration, pause, and interruption gates, with explicit reject for every failed or ambiguous case. Numeric implementation thresholds remain gated on the future frozen study.

The brief distinguishes legacy whole-sequence 15 dB fixtures from the concurrent corpus repair's explicit active-tone-mask 10 dB fixtures. Those nominal-frequency files remain deterministic inputs, not an independent combined impairment grid or accuracy result.

The 99% clean, 95% at 10 dB, and <=40 ms values are labeled prospective goals only. The brief forbids populated confusion matrices, accuracy claims, or measured-latency claims until the complete executable protocol is frozen and run.

window_handoff: The lesson may expose rectangular-window half-bin leakage and zero-padding failure, but window selection remains owned by windows-leakage-and-resolution and the forward exercise must include a Ref.
